attach.space: Original source Head local; no extra body-scale/translation baked
attach.parent: Original Head-control bone attachment, transform applied once

material.type: Unlit source paint + original arch vertex palette with limited geometric shade
material.safeGLTFFallback: Unlit COLOR_0 only. It intentionally does not show complete custom source paint.
material.uv: TEXCOORD_0=(sourcePx/1920,1-sourcePy/1080); original frill radial-interval UV remap by u where observed. This is a semantic UV remap, not a per-source-vertex UV lock. Original image unchanged; Godot samples (UV.x,1-UV.y) once
material.palette: COLOR_0 source linear float RGB sampled from original headband arch; do not silently pack into lossy RGBA8
material.sourceImage: Original sRGB texture; decode to linear before blend, encode to display once
material.culling: Back-face culling on a genuinely closed solid shell

deformation.initial: Rigid Head attachment only; this component does not claim cloth dynamics
deformation.future: Canonical u,v,layer domain permits external cloth controls; preserve inner/outer radial separation and run collision checks before enabling physics

metadata.coordinateSystem: Original Head local +Y up +Z front; no scene-scale calibration

domain.embedding: Rotated ellipsoid direction followed by a positive radial graph; inner layer uses identical directions and finite radial thickness. No cropped-outline station forcing.

metadata.sourcePaint: Original frill white-grey source radial-interval UV remap by u where observed; high-chroma neighbouring hair samples reconstruct from original arch palette. Unknown cloth is inferred, not original-author paint.
metadata.thicknessMode: Finite radial distance, .003 uncalibrated source units by default; no average-normal fold inversion
metadata.physicalStatus: Rest geometry only; not yet cloth dynamics or complete avatar physics

limitations: Unknown cloth depth/paint are source-guided inference, not an author scan
Other original hair layers/body/face remain unchanged and imperfect
Self-crossing diagnostics exclude coplanar and shared-vertex pairs; actual hair contact/physics needs independent checks
